svg.aria-label: Tom Bruno, Product and Ecosystem Leader in AI Ecosystems at Google. AI is only as useful as the ecosystem it can safely reach. A map traces his path from Nairobi to Dublin to San Francisco, with TB at the centre of agents, protocols, publishers, merchants, value exchange, trust and developers.
